configurations.name: web
runtimeArgs: set -a; . ../../.env; set +a; export DATABASE_URL=$TEST_DATABASE_URL; exec npm run dev

configurations.name: web (signed in)
runtimeArgs: set -a; . ../../.env; set +a; export DATABASE_URL=$TEST_DATABASE_URL; AUTH_DEV_BYPASS=1 exec npm run dev

configurations.name: engine api
runtimeArgs: set -a; . ../../.env; set +a; export DATABASE_URL=$TEST_DATABASE_URL; exec .venv/bin/uvicorn engine.api.app:app --port 8931
